title: Count the films
text: Connection fields return a totalCount next to the rows.

title: Who directed the most films?
text: Film counts are stored on each person (and refreshed after every mutation), so this is one sorted query.
command:
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "{ people(sort: [{ directedCount: DESC }], limit: 3) { name directedCount } }"}'

title: Filter and nest
text: Filters use operators such as contains (case-sensitive), eq and gte; relationships nest.
command:
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "{ movies(where: { title: { contains: \"Matrix\" } }) { title released genres { name } } }"}'

title: Read the error, fix the statement
text: GraphQL answers HTTP 200 with an errors array; the message says what to fix, here with a suggestion. The second command is the corrected statement. This is the loop an agent follows.
command:
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "{ movies(where: { titel: \"x\" }) { title } }"}'
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "{ movies(where: { title: { eq: \"Heat\" } }) { title released } }"}'
output:
{"errors":[{"message":"Field \"titel\" is not defined by type \"MovieWhere\". Did you mean \"title\"?","locations":[{"line":1,"column":19}],"extensions":{"code":"GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED"}}]}
{"data":{"movies":[{"title":"Heat","released":1995}]}}

title: Create a film, then remove it
text: Writes are open on the default stack. The first statement creates a film with a connected actor; the second deletes it again. Always filter a delete.
command:
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "mutation { createMovies(input: [{ title: \"ZZ Example\", released: 2031 }]) { movies { title released } } }"}'
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "mutation { deleteMovies(where: { title: { eq: \"ZZ Example\" } }) { nodesDeleted } }"}'

title: List the MCP tools
text: The MCP server speaks JSON-RPC over HTTP; send both Accept types. It is stateless, so no handshake is needed.
output:
event: message
data: {"result":{"tools":[{"name":"get_schema","description":"Summary of the GraphQL API: root query and mutation fields with their arguments, and the object types the schema defines with their fields and descriptions. G ...

title: Run a query through MCP
text: run_query returns the JSON result as text.
command:
curl -s localhost:4100/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"run_query","arguments":{"query":"{ moviesConnection { totalCount } }"}}}'

title: Mutations are off by default
text: The refusal comes back as text with isError, so the agent can read it. To allow writes, start compose with AGENTS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true (the server sees it as ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true).
command:
curl -s localhost:4100/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"run_mutation","arguments":{"query":"mutation { deleteMovies { nodesDeleted } }"}}}'
output:
event: message
data: {"result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Mutations are disabled. This server is read-only by default: start it with ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true to let an agent change data. See docs/guardrails.md."}],"isError":true},"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3}

title: One query, two sources
text: The gateway asks Neo4j for the film and Wikipedia (through the Wikipedia subgraph) for the summary.
command:
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "{ movies(where: { title: { eq: \"Heat\" } }) { title released wikipedia { description pageUrl } } }"}'

title: No link, no error
text: A person with no Wikipedia link returns null for the Wikipedia fields, with no error.
command:
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "{ people(where: { name: { eq: \"Madonna\" } }) { name wikipediaTitle wikipedia { title } } }"}'

title: An anonymous write is refused
text: With grandstack-auth, reads are public but writes need a token. The gateway answers before the request reaches the server.
command:
curl -s localhost:4000/graphql -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "mutation { deleteMovies(where: { title: { eq: \"ZZ none\" } }) { nodesDeleted } }"}'
